To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
swarm intelligence algorithms are social systems that can be characterized by their interaction network, a network that is the result of the interactions of the agents in the system.
1. Swarm intelligence is a metaphor that refers to the self-organization of a system of agents.

(i) the social interactions in swarm-based algorithms can be modeled as a network; (ii) the network structure is an important factor in the performance of the algorithm, and (iii) the network structure can be used to characterize and compare different swarm-based algorithms.
